name: Jeshua (Levite)
title: Levite who explained the law to the people
summary: Jeshua was one of the Levites who helped Ezra explain the law to the people when it was read aloud, so that everyone could understand it.

keyEvents.title: Explaining the Law
keyEvents.description: Jeshua was among the Levites who made God's law understandable to the people during the reading.
